remarks: WELCOME to 699 Losson Road. This single family home has been well maintained and updated over the last 18 years. Oversized 30' x 40' detached garage/workshop offers exceptional storage and workspace potential. Ideal for projects, equipment storage, hobby use, or other permitted uses. Ample parking and functional outdoor space add to the property's versatility Brand new 30 amp underground service installed last year. Set up your workshop. Heated with a wood burning stove. The home features a  Large living room and dining room. Kitchen off the dining room was updated 5 yrs ago. Original wood work still shows throughout the home. Original solid core doors to all the bedrooms. Crown molding in Kitchen, dining room, living room, and up the stairs into the upper hallway. New carpet in the 1st floor bedroom/office and up the stairs and upper hall way. Hardwood flooring is under all current flooring materials except in Kitchen and upstairs bathroom. The basement has 9' ceilings and is freshly painted and cleaned ready for you to make it your own. Plenty of parking here for up to 8 cars up top and ample parking below for any equipment you might need to store. Leased Solar panels on the rear of the roof assist with your energy needs.
